latest.title: v1.3.1
latest.summary: Independent week calendar navigation, auto-completing Classroom tasks, and cleaner fonts.

changes.title: Calendar Week Navigation
changes.description: Week view now moves week-by-week independently of Month view.

changes.title: Google Classroom Auto-Completion
changes.description: Submitted and graded assignments now automatically mark as completed.

changes.title: Refined Typography
changes.description: Updated headings to Sora and DM Sans fonts.

changes.title: Flashcard Search & Bulk Delete
changes.description: Filter decks by title or tag, and delete multiple decks at once.

changes.title: Deck Settings Modal
changes.description: Rename decks and assign courses from a dedicated modal.

changes.title: Cleaner Page Layouts
changes.description: Simplified task creator and updated empty states across views.

changes.title: Notes Split View
changes.description: Side-by-side sidebar navigation and note editor.

changes.title: Custom Avatars & Dashboard Cards
changes.description: Upload custom profile photos and view taller dashboard stat cards.

changes.title: Dark Mode Polish
changes.description: Fixed dialog styling and calendar hover states in dark mode.

changes.title: What's New Modal
changes.description: Added popup release notes for new updates.

changes.title: Persistent Sessions
changes.description: Your profile, notes, and decks now persist across updates.

changes.title: Faster Classroom Sync
changes.description: Faster sync for courses, announcements, and deadlines.

changes.title: Flashcard Shortcuts & Animations
changes.description: Added number key shortcuts (1-4) and smoother card flip animations.

changes.title: Dark Mode Contrast
changes.description: Improved contrast and focus rings in dark mode.

changes.title: Mobile Drawer Polish
changes.description: Smoother mobile menu animations and tap targets.

changes.title: AI Flashcard Generator
changes.description: Generate flashcard decks directly from uploaded PDFs and notes.

changes.title: Dashboard Customization
changes.description: Drag and reorder cards on your dashboard.

changes.title: Week Calendar View
changes.description: Switch between Month and Week views on the calendar.

changes.title: Pomodoro Tracking
changes.description: Automatically track completed focus sessions and streaks.

changes.title: Initial Release
changes.description: Calendar, Pomodoro timer, To-Do list, and Notes.
